title: Bratislava Castle
visualBrief: White four-wing palace around a real open courtyard, unequal square/octagonal corner towers and swept terracotta crowns; curved Court of Honour pavilions, separate gates, mapped barracks, riding hall and Baroque garden.

nativeAxes.origin: Signed grounds anchor; Y0 decoded 202.3571 m working datum.

sourceFacts.identity: Q593311 identifies grounds way/1128350263; palace Q13425656 is way/8160490 and relation/14610630.

reconstruction.basis: OSM independent parts fix the palace, courtyard, towers, gates and garden plan. Official tourist-board photographs and the NR SR 2018 reconstruction illustration guide exterior forms.
reconstruction.verticalDatum: Fresh grounds way1128350263 v23 identifies Q593311; palace way8160490 identifies Q13425656. Native +X NNE at 31.587323 degrees clockwise from north and +Z ESE at 121.587323 degrees sign heading 1.019493535917 at [17.100792149,48.142390437]. Southwest Crown Tower, south triple portal/Court of Honour and north Baroque garden confirm the frame. Current hedge/path vertices differ from original up to 0.570799 m; derivative uses fresh points while original source remains reproducible. All four gate centers and tunnel directions follow mapped passage/footprint intersections; three original tunnel bearings were transverse to their roads and have been corrected. Public numeric terrain supplies 16641 values on a 4 m native grid. Decoded Y0 working datum 202.3571 m; palace/court floor 5.2147 m above anchor is highest occupied platform sample plus 0.25 m, with rigid -4.7853 m translation. Garden/riding hall retain this interpreted level. Other barracks and gates use separate footprint/entry samples, bounded ramps and buried retaining feet. The broader hillside/park remains exclusively host terrain, with no ground cut or whole-grounds replacement.
reconstruction.state: Restored Baroque palace and garden; Great Moravian church survives as low archaeological foundations.

geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.

Coarse terrain cannot resolve paved terraces, narrow retaining walls, building feet or underground parking. Pixel ground spacing is a sample interval, not surveyed resolution. Native vertical datum/vintage/under-building contamination remain unverified.

Palace/forecourt level is the highest occupied platform sample plus 0.25 m; one rigid palace shift preserves its relative architectural heights. Garden/riding hall keep that explicitly interpreted level; four historical garden terraces remain unmeasured. Other barracks and gates use separate highest footprint/entry samples plus 0.15/0.12 m with bounded civil connections.

Mapped structural skirts extend four meters below retained ground. Broad park/hill is exclusively host terrain. No whole-precinct cut or replacement. Crown Tower 47 m published height versus OSM 31 m part height has unresolved datum scope; interpreted roof-tip height is retained, not called surveyed.

Accepted exterior scope is the four-wing palace/open court, unequal corner towers, swept crowns, south portals/curved pavilions, four entrance gates, mapped barracks/riding hall, garden/parterre/fountain, low archaeological foundations and perimeter walls. Interiors, underground parking, mature trees and detailed figurative garden sculpture are separate scope. Equestrian Svátopluk remains an original interpretive silhouette, not a likeness.

Six common graphs provide granite, lime plaster, wood, painted metal, ceramic tile and gravel. Carved white trim shares tinted plaster; bronze sculpture shares metal; dark dormer/clock recesses share opaque glass. No embedded images. Texture courses replace duplicated roof-course geometry. Skyline bakes shared linear material means.

Official 2014/2016 photographs and 2023 brochure depict restored castle/garden; NR SR2018 illustration is a reconstruction proposal, not a survey. Palace height datum, bay/window counts, gate body envelopes, garden levels and exact terrace foundations remain interpreted. No physical phone/laptop timings claimed.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
